title: AI Loop wizard mode: wizard offers 'Let AI drive' as primary choice alongside manual depth selection — one target, one approval tier, AI handles the rest
goal: The wizard should offer operators a simple choice: (A) 'Let AI drive' — operator enters target, sets maximum authorization tier (passive-only / active / full pentest), AI handles everything within that tier autonomously with tier-escalation approval prompts. (B) 'Manual' — current depth selection (Passive/Active/Full Pentest) with fixed phase execution. For 'Let AI drive': wizard collects only three things: (1) Target (URL/IP/CIDR/domain — AI auto-detects target type), (2) Maximum tier ('Keep it passive' / 'Allow active scanning' / 'Full assessment including credential testing' / 'Full pentest with exploitation'), (3) Optional: credentials if operator has them (passed to AI for use when relevant). Operator clicks 'Start — AI drives from here'. Mission Control shows the live loop: each iteration AI narrates what it found and what it's doing next. Operator sees the reasoning in real-time. Approval prompts appear at tier boundaries. This is the 'product that a non-expert can use' vision: you give it a target, tell it how aggressive it can be, and it finds everything findable within those boundaries.
scope: The AI Continuous Assessment Loop (backlog-260) needs a clean wizard entry point. The current wizard asks too many questions. For AI-driven mode: target + max tier is sufficient. AI figures out the rest. This is the 'easy button' for operators who trust the AI to drive.
generation_reason: AI loop needs a simple wizard entry point. Three questions: target + max tier + credentials. AI handles everything else. Non-expert-friendly.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add 'Let AI drive' as a wizard mode alongside existing manual mode. Never remove manual mode.

success_criteria: Wizard Step 1 shows two top-level choices: 'Let AI drive' and 'Manual assessment'.
AI drive mode collects: target + max tier + optional credentials only.
Manual mode shows current tile/depth selection unchanged.
Mission Control shows AI narration: iteration reasoning visible.
Tier approval prompts appear at escalation boundaries.
No regression in manual mode wizard tests.
